children: Jason Ronald Krantz disclosed beneficial ownership of a 17.6% stake in Definitive Healthcare Corp.'s Class A common stock. He filed a Schedule 13D on Sep. 02, 2026, converting from a prior 13G after Advent International proposed a take-private deal on Sep. 1. The move signals that Krantz may support a transaction by rolling his equity into the surviving company.

Advent International proposed to buy the shares it does not own for $1.02 per share, and it based the offer on Krantz rolling all his Class A shares and LLC Units into the post-deal company. Krantz said he will consider this plan and discuss terms with Advent and the special committee, noting the proposal is "premised on the Reporting Person rolling over all his Class A Common Stock and LLC Units into equity of the surviving company."

Krantz emphasized that "no binding obligation" exists and he "reserves the right to modify or withdraw at any time" his consideration. If no deal occurs, he may evaluate alternatives, including third-party proposals, more share purchases, or sales, while his role as Executive Chairman could influence the company’s path.

Jason Ronald Krantz founded Definitive Healthcare and serves as its Executive Chairman. He is also the Managing Partner and Founder of Breachway Capital, a venture capital and growth equity firm focused on scaling software and data businesses. Krantz has built and invested in healthcare data and analytics companies with a long-term, operator-led approach.
